items.title: 天琴留声
items.prompt: A square Art Deco heraldic portrait for Astra Yao, a late-night radio host represented by her own insignia. Center an obsidian vinyl disc with a crimson velvet label, align a champagne-gold lyre with its upper rim, and sweep a fine musical staff diagonally toward a vintage microphone. Let narrow grazing light reveal the record grooves, with a soft burgundy halo and four-pointed stars around the silhouette.
items.negative_prompt: Plastic shine, heavy lens flare, crowded notes, misshapen microphone, random lettering, watermark

items.title: 夜藏者
items.prompt: An Art Deco portrait of a midnight record collector told through her belongings, composed as a wide two-panel engraving. Place a closed oxblood velvet sleeve with crisp foil stamping on the left and an obsidian record with a crimson center label on the right. A narrow champagne-gold spotlight rakes across the grooves, while four-pointed corner stars and a fine metal border frame the black negative space.
items.negative_prompt: Oversaturated red, warped circles, glossy plastic sleeve, clutter, illegible text, watermark

items.title: 末曲余晖
items.prompt: A wide, empty recital stage just after the last encore, viewed straight on at floor height. Arrange a small cairn of polished obsidian on the centerline beneath a dim crimson sun and leave broad pools of shadow on either side. Rake a champagne-gold footlight across the lacquered floor to catch the stacked edges, while fine concentric rings fade into a backdrop of wine-red velvet.
items.negative_prompt: Audience, visible rigging, neon colors, blown highlights, thick smoke, watermark

items.title: 夜航信标
items.prompt: A wide Art Deco panorama of three night relay beacons along a rising signal path. Set the first two low against an obsidian horizon and let the far-right tower rise into a warm champagne-gold halo. Etch celestial meridians into the black backdrop and run a fine crimson trace beneath the main path, with low side light revealing satin brass and a velvet-red haze at the edge of the frame.
items.negative_prompt: Busy skyline, harsh neon, thick fog, sci-fi interface clutter, random text, logo

items.title: 绒幕星轨
items.prompt: A vertical macro cover photograph of an obsidian vinyl record resting on folds of crimson velvet. Crop the disc boldly at the right edge and place the brushed champagne-gold spindle just above the centerline. Sweep a soft strip light across the grooves at a grazing angle, let a narrow red rim light pick out the velvet nap, and thread fine orbital arcs through the dark corners.

items.title: 字隙微光
items.prompt: A wide typographic specimen on obsidian-black card, arranged in two balanced panels inside a fine Art Deco frame. Build a single ivory glyph from geometric strokes over a champagne-gold calligraphy grid on the left, then use measured ivory rules and a small velvet-crimson seal on the right. Graze the panels from the upper left so foil edges glint and the pressed paper fibers stay visible in the shadows.
items.negative_prompt: Random paragraphs, distorted grid, busy ornament, illegible pseudo-text, metallic glare, watermark
